capabilities: Drag lines by a gutter handle to reorder them
Move whole list items with nested children
Move heading sections up to the next heading of equal or higher level
Move entire callouts and code blocks from their first line
Undo each drag as a single edit
extras: Desktop only (relies on mouse events); works in Live Preview and Source mode but not Reading view.
problem: Reordering blocks like list items or sections in Obsidian requires cutting and pasting text instead of dragging them.
summary: Drag-and-drop reordering of lines, list items, headings, callouts and code blocks in the editor via a gutter handle.
